assam_ceo_ae2021_final_ps_electors_phase.description: CEO Assam, General Election to Assam Legislative Assembly 2021: 'Total Polling Station and General Electors - PHASE wise' (5 pages; columns S.No, Name of Revenue District, Name of the Election District, AC No & Name, Total PS, General Electors). Linked as 'Total numbers of Polling Station and Elector details in Phase wise' from https://ceoassam.nic.in/assembly/2021/assembly-election-2021.html. PRIMARY source of district_2008 for the 126 pre-2023 (1976-order) ACs.

assam_ceo_ae2021_page.html.description: CEO Assam AE-2021 page (provenance of the PDF above; links are in its inline JS 'sections' array).

manipur_ceo_officers_contact.html.description: CEO Manipur 'Who's Who of Election Officials': table of Electoral Registration Officers with columns District | AC Name ('N - Name') | ERO | Designation | Email. PRIMARY source of district_2008 for Manipur's 60 ACs (unchanged since the 1976 order).

nagaland_ceo_polling_stations_page.html.description: CEO Nagaland 'Assembly Constituencies and Polling Stations' page listing one PDF per election district (16 files).

nagaland_ceo_ps/*.description: CEO Nagaland polling-station list of one election district; each AC block is headed 'List of Polling Stations for N - NAME Assembly Constituency comprised within the NAGALAND Parliamentary Constituency'. PRIMARY source of district_2008 for Nagaland's 60 ACs. NB '7. Zunheboto.pdf' carries 9 appended pages (11-19) repeating ACs 49-58 of other districts; those repeats are ignored.

jharkhand_ceo_acpclist.html.description: CEO Jharkhand 'AC & PC LIST - JHARKHAND' (Details of AC): division / No. & Name of District / No. & Name of ACs / parts, plus a PC-wise half. PRIMARY source of district_2008 for Jharkhand's 81 ACs (24 districts = the 24 Census-2011 districts).

dpaco_1976_archiveorg_djvu.txt.description: OCR text (Internet Archive, tesseract) of 'The Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 1976' as printed by the Election Commission of India (uploaded 2024-05-11; item description says it was retrieved from the ECI's 'Archive Delimitation Orders' page). The governing order for these four states: Assam = Schedule IV, Bihar (incl. the 81 Jharkhand ACs, Bihar Nos. 147-164 and 262-324) = Schedule V, Manipur = Schedule XIV, Nagaland = Schedule XVI. Source of ac_name, the 1976 district headings and every AC's extent (used to document cross-district territory).

dpaco_1976_archiveorg_metadata.json.description: Internet Archive metadata of the item above (creator, provenance, file list with checksums).
